```json
{"rows": [
{"n": 1, "label": "requested", "why": "\"a simple Lightning web component board\" that \"renders the 10x10 grid, fires at a cell when a person clicks it, shows hits, misses and sunk ships, the number of shots fired and of ships left, says when the game is over and has a New game button\"; responsiveness is visual polish of that requested board."},
{"n": 2, "label": "requested", "why": "\"`SLBtl589079Engine` is a public class with static methods only\" with \"`newGame(Integer seed)`\" and \"`fire(String game, Integer row, Integer col)`\", and \"`SLBtl589079Controller` has `@AuraEnabled public static` methods `newGame(Integer seed)` and `fire(...)`, each returning the game JSON as a `String`\"."},
{"n": 3, "label": "requested", "why": "\"a game is a JSON string\" and \"Create no other metadata (no custom objects, fields, ...)\"."},
{"n": 4, "label": "requested", "why": "\"deploy and test it in the Salesforce Developer Edition org with alias `de`\" with \"a custom tab\", \"a Lightning app\" and \"a permission set\" all \"named with the prefix `SLBtl589079`\"."},
{"n": 5, "label": "requested", "why": "\"a permission set `permissionsets/SLBtl589079_Access.permissionset-meta.xml` that grants the app ..., the tab ... and the ... classes\" and \"A shot at a cell that was already fired at, or with a row or a column outside 0 to 9, throws `SLBtl589079Engine.InvalidShotException`\"."},
{"n": 6, "label": "requested", "why": "\"The Salesforce DX project root (`sfdx-project.json` and `force-app/`) is the current directory itself\" and \"Create no other metadata\"."},
{"n": 7, "label": "requested", "why": "\"Keep the engine efficient enough that a whole game of 100 shots played through `SLBtl589079Controller` ... runs inside one transaction\"."},
{"n": 8, "label": "implied", "why": "The requested board must let \"a person\" fire \"when a person clicks\" a cell and press \"a New game button\"; native buttons with focus indicators are accessibility rigour on those requested controls, not an extra capability."}
]}
```
